For multi_document cases use facts from TWO DIFFERENT source documents and ask one coherent question requiring both. For ambiguous cases create genuinely under-specified questions requiring clarification, expected_status clarify, facts []. Do not label a clear policy question ambiguous. Vary topics. Never duplicate questions already generated. Return only JSON with cases.
